spotlight.blurb: Optic bounces beams off every wall. Line up the angles and let geometry do the work.
Fuse drops a mine on every bounce. Corners get dangerous fast.
Chill's icy trail slows everything down to its sleepy pace.
Bramble hits back whenever it gets hit. Leave it alone if you can.
Dupe splits in two at half HP. Double the jelly, double the trouble.
Now you see it, now you don't.
Everything drifts towards it in the end.
